notes: Encoded ONLY from Grandaire's own page. No ICP or other-family content imported, even though the brand is ICP-family. COUNTING: the page says 'numerical digits' on all three styles, but digit-only counting is FALSIFIED page-wide by styles 1/2 (6th & 7th numerical digits would be '16', an invalid month), so character-position counting governs all styles on this page. That also resolves page Style 3, where digit-only counting would otherwise give a competing valid reading (1972, week 51) — rejected because styles 1/2 falsify digit-only counting on this page (Nordyne lesson).

styles.era: 12-character serials, 3 letters + 9 digits, year + month (page styles 1 and 2 combined)
styles.notes: Page styles 1 (GQB030201629) and 2 (GQB0302-01629) normalize to the identical serial, so one style covers both forms. Year = 4th & 5th characters -> [3,5] -> '03' -> 2003; month = 6th & 7th characters -> [5,7] -> '02'. Digit-only counting falsified: 4th & 5th numerical digits would be '20' and 6th & 7th '16' (invalid month).

styles.era: 10-character serials, 1 letter + 9 digits, year + week (page style 3)
styles.notes: Year = 2nd & 3rd characters -> [1,3] -> '07' -> 2007; week = 4th & 5th characters -> [3,5] -> '25'. Character counting per the page-wide determination in the brand notes (digit-only counting is falsified by styles 1/2); the digit-only alternative for this style alone (1972, week 51) is NOT shipped.
